message.content: {"output_action": "PATCH", "skill_draft": null, "patch_target_id": "t000006", "patch_section": "Core Action", "patch_content": "If automated tools (e.g., classifier, report generator) return 'normal' findings or fail to detect a specific focal abnormality while clinical context suggests otherwise: (1) Use tool outputs only to rule out widespread pathology (e.g., large consolidations); (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original image pixels to identify specific morphological features (e.g., location, wall thickness, fluid levels); (3) Integrate the specific clinical context (e.g., symptoms, history) provided in the question stem to resolve ambiguity in visual findings; (4) Base the final diagnosis on the synthesis of pixel evidence and clinical context rather than conflicting automated reports."}
